YYL_STS2_MOD-DONG_NI_ZHI_BA.description: Block you gain is always set to 15. (Removed at the end of combat.)
YYL_STS2_MOD-DONG_NI_ZHI_BA.title: Toni's Supremacy
YYL_STS2_MOD-NAILONG_REARING.description: Each time you kill a [gold]Nailong[/gold], gain 1 stack (max [blue]20[/blue]). Each stack increases damage you deal to [gold]Nailong[/gold] by [blue]5%[/blue].
YYL_STS2_MOD-NAILONG_REARING.flavor: You have finally made up your mind to raise it.
YYL_STS2_MOD-NAILONG_REARING.title: Raise the Nailong
YYL_STS2_MOD-NL_CAN2.description: At the start of combat, gain 5 Qi. Treat all as Nailong; only when the relic holder personally kills a Nailong do they heal 3 HP.
YYL_STS2_MOD-NL_CAN2.flavor: A whole can of tissue samples from the yellow creature; the vivid yellow trembles in the air. You begin to hear its voice.
YYL_STS2_MOD-NL_CAN2.title: Large Yellow Peach Can
YYL_STS2_MOD-PEACH_CAN.description: At the start of combat, gain 3 Qi. Treat all enemies as Nailong.
YYL_STS2_MOD-PEACH_CAN.flavor: A glass can holding a chunk of tissue sample from the yellow creature. The sample pulses slowly.
YYL_STS2_MOD-PEACH_CAN.title: Yellow Peach Can
YYL_STS2_MOD-SNAKE_FLOWER_MISS.title: Snake Flower Miss
YYL_STS2_MOD-SNAKE_FLOWER_MISS.descripti: At the start of combat, summon Snake Flower Miss (8 HP). If she survives the combat, her Max HP increases by 3 next combat.
YYL_STS2_MOD-SNAKE_FLOWER_MISS.flavor: The one you crushed will never grow back.
